name: Tar-Baphon's Shadow
description: A manifestation of Tar-Baphon drains the essence of its divine target.
disable: DC 33 Arcana (expert) to disrupt Tar-Baphon's magic, DC 30 Occultism or DC 30 Religion (master) to suppress the shadow's energy; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt unless the Carcass Man is destroyed, in which case it's automatically destroyed
routine: (1 action; death) The haunt drains Zagresh's divine energies, dealing 5d10 Void Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unholy Leech
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the cavern

Effect The shadow latches onto the Carcass Man, unleashing a 30ft Type:emanation of necromantic energy. Creatures in the area except the Carcass Man must make a DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take 2d12 Void Damage damage. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is pushed back 15 feet.

Critical Failure As failure and the creature is Stunned 1 and knocked Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unholy Presence
offensiveAbilities.description: The shadow is sustained by the power of Tar-Baphon, regaining 10 Hit Points at the beginning of every round, and is repaired by void damage.
